page.overview:
Who is Akka?

Akka is an alien martial artist hailing from the planet Sklar, which is ruled by an empowered matriarchy. She believed in survival of the fittest, pledging herself to the powerful Saturn Queen while also killing Micro Lad in cold blood for being weaker.

The murder got her an invitation to the Legion of Super-Villains, however Saturn Queen later betrayed her loyalty by killing Akka with her own blade as a sacrifice to empower Hunter.
